legend.en: Once a foe is marked for destruction, the Angels of Death must not relent until the target is annihilated.

when.en: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.

effect.en: Your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. SECONDARY EFFECT: If your unit is a VEHICLE unit, have +1 to wound rolls.

legend.en: These warriors emulate the mechanical monstrosities at whose side they fight, shrugging off wounds both physical and spiritual.

when.en: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit suffers a mortal wound.

effect.en: Your unit has Feel no pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

legend.en: Carefully cogitated binharic prayers can focus a machine spirit’s ire into near-obsessive hatred of its slayers, ensuring that vengeance is meted out even in death.

when.en: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit is destroyed, before rolling for deadly demise.

target.en: That friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.

effect.en: Change any deadly demise rolls made for this unit to an unmodified 6.

legend.en: The heroes entombed within Dreadnoughts have fought across countless war zones throughout their extended existences, perfecting their martial prowess beyond mortal limits.

target.en: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT unit.

effect.en: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has: +1" M. +1 T. +1 Ld. +1 OC. +1 to hit rolls.

legend.en: Space Marines exemplify obdurate tenacity. Even severely injured, they will never abandon their oaths.

target.en: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is below starting strength.

effect.en: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s: BS and WS. Hit rolls and Wound rolls.

legend.en: There are many tales of machine spirits wreaking havoc on the foe, even after the crew of their vehicle are slain and critical systems are failing.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit has shot.

effect.en: Your unit shoots using: Snap shooting. Or: If your unit is at half-strength/below half-strength, normal shooting. While doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
